description.value: BrewHouse is a microbrewery pub in Whistler with regional cuisine and on-site brewing operations. The venue features both indoor and outdoor seating along Blackcomb Way in the heart of the village. It serves as a natural food and beverage stop for touring cyclists passing through Whistler.
